description: Deploy a new agent from a template or as a custom build from chosen skills. In a team workspace only a team admin can deploy; anyone else is refused before anything is created or charged. This costs money: the first 30 days are paid from the Wiro wallet of the connected project's workspace (a team project pays from the team wallet), and the plan renews from that wallet every 30 days until it is cancelled. Without confirm: true the tool only returns the exact quote. Show it to the user, get their approval, then repeat the call with confirm: true and confirm_charge_usd set to the quoted price; if the price changed in between, nothing is charged and a new quote comes back. Never repeat a confirmed deploy that timed out or whose outcome is unknown without checking list_my_agents first. A refusal that says nothing was created or charged, such as one for balance, can be confirmed again once its cause is fixed and the user says yes. The agent starts on its own after deployment. Credentials can be added later with set_agent_credentials, connect_agent_oauth or, for a Wiro project, bind_agent_project, but skills that need them do not work until then. A custom build also gets the scheduled tasks its skills come with; the result names the ones that are on, and they can be changed or turned off. A build whose skills bring none gets a starter task, which stays off until it is written and turned on with manage_agent_custom_skill. The quote names the wallet and the other tier's price. In a team workspace the agent starts with collaborative chats, which every team member sees; update_agent changes that after the deploy. To change a template's skills, deploy it first and then use apply_agent_skills. get_playbook describes the whole flow.

confirm.description: false returns only the quote. true deploys the agent and charges the wallet. Set it only after the user approved the quoted price.

confirm_charge_usd.description: With confirm: true, the price the user approved, from the quote's nextAction (quote.priceUsd). Required to deploy. If a fresh quote no longer matches it, nothing is charged and the new quote is returned.

cover.description: Optional https image URL for the agent cover. A template deploy shows the template cover when it is left out.

credentials.description: Optional credential values stored at deployment, keyed by credential key and then field key, for example {"telegram": {"bottoken": "...", "allowedusers": ["123456789"]}}. A chat channel group must contain every required field. Values are never shown back. Other credentials are better set after deployment with set_agent_credentials, which reports field errors.

custom.description: true for a custom build from `skills` instead of a template.

custom_skills.description: Optional custom instructions or scheduled tasks added at deployment, or changes to the ones the template comes with. They are checked before the quote.

description.description: Short description shown in the dashboard.

enabled.description: Whether the entry is on (default true). false turns off a scheduled task that comes with the template.

interval.description: A 5-field cron expression in the agent's timezone (UTC until changed with update_agent), for example "0 9 * * 1-5". Setting it makes the entry a scheduled task. Left out, a scheduled task that comes with the template keeps the template's schedule.

key.description: The entry's key: a full key (cs-... or cs-cron-...) or a bare slug such as "weekly-report" (lowercase letters, digits, single dashes). A bare slug names the template's own entry of that name when it has one; otherwise it becomes cs-<slug>, or cs-cron-<slug> with interval.

value.description: The instruction text the agent follows, or the prompt a scheduled task runs. Required for a new entry. Leave it out for an entry that comes with the template: a custom skill then keeps the template's text, and a scheduled task always runs the template's own prompt, so only its interval and enabled can change.

skills.description: Custom build only: skill names from list_agent_skills. Skills they depend on are added and priced automatically. An empty list deploys an agent with no extra skills at the minimum price.

template.description: Template slug or guid from list_agent_templates. Leave it out for a custom build.

tier.description: Plan tier. Pro has a larger monthly credit pool and is the only tier that can buy extra credit packs.

title.description: Name of the new agent. Required for a custom build. A template deploy defaults to the template title.

name: deploy_agent

monthly.description: The monthly credits this period grants. A plan change inside a period moves it for the time left, so it can differ from renewal.

renewal.description: The monthly credits each renewal grants.

lastActivityAt.description: When the agent's newest message was written, on any channel, scheduled runs included. Left out when it has none.

setupRequired.description: Whether the agent waits for setup. list_my_agents goes by the status (6). get_my_agent also checks each required credential and names what is missing.

amountUsd.description: What the plan costs every 30 days. For a plan that has ended, the agent's monthly price, which is what a renew charges.

atPeriodEnd.description: For an active plan, what happens at periodEndsAt: it renews, it ends, or unknown for a card plan whose renewal is managed in the Wiro dashboard.

defaultScheduledTasks.description: The scheduled tasks a custom build came with that are already on, with the schedule they came with.

approvalPolicy.description: What custom_skills does to the agent's approval policy. Tell the user before they approve.

pricing.description: What this agent costs on each tier, every 30 days.

teamSessionMode.description: In a team workspace: the chat mode the new agent starts with.

wallet.description: The wallet this charge comes from, as far as it can be read.

storeRevenueUsd.description: The part of balanceUsd that is store revenue, when there is any.

title: Deploy a Wiro agent
